description: Unit test script for the printing module in webkitpy layout tests, including test cases for configuration, directory timings, summaries, status lines, and output formatting.

classes.name: FakeRunResults
classes.description: Mock class simulating test run results with customizable total, expected, unexpected counts, and shard results.

classes.name: FakeShard
classes.description: Mock class representing a shard with a name and total run time.

classes.name: Testprinter
classes.description: Test case class containing various unit tests for the printing module, including configuration, directory timings, summaries, and output formatting.

methods.name: get_options
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to obtain printing options.

methods.name: test_print_options
methods.description: Tests that print options can be retrieved successfully.

methods.name: get_printer
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Printer instance along with its output stream.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Creates a mock test result with specified name, type, and runtime.

methods.name: test_configure_and_cleanup
methods.description: Verifies that cleanup can be called multiple times safely.

methods.name: test_print_config
methods.description: Tests the output of the print_config method with various options.

methods.name: test_print_directory_timings
methods.description: Tests directory timing output based on shard results.

methods.name: test_print_one_line_summary
methods.description: Verifies the summary line output for different test counts and timings.

methods.name: test_test_status_line
methods.description: Tests the formatting of test status lines under different console widths.

methods.name: test_details
methods.description: Checks that detailed test output is printed when requested.

methods.name: test_print_found
methods.description: Tests the output message for the number of tests found and run.

methods.name: test_debug_rwt_logging_is_throttled
methods.description: Ensures that debug logging for RWT is throttled to a single line per test.
